name: Hülya Biyan
bio: Hülya Biyan was born in 1981 in Sivas. She finished primary, middle, and high school in Bursa. She chose to be a teacher because she loves introducing children to books, exploring their world, sharing new ideas, widening their view of life, and spending time with them. After sixteen years of teaching, she continued her career as a trainer and coach. The colorful world of her twin daughters, along with her students, became her biggest inspiration in writing. Books and writing are her greatest passion. She enjoys working with children to contribute to their reading and writing journeys.
